text: That's OpenCrabs answering on a Mac. Here's how you get there, with one Homebrew command.
Open Terminal. Press Command and Space, type Terminal, and press Enter.
Type brew install opencrabs, and press Enter. Homebrew downloads the ready-made build for Apple Silicon, plus two small helpers.
If Terminal says command not found, brew, you don't have Homebrew yet. Install it from brew dot s h, the command is in the description, then run this line again.
Now type opencrabs and press Enter. The setup wizard opens. It's the same wizard as in the Linux video, so here's the fast version.
QuickStart. Keep the dot opencrabs folder with Seed template files ticked, that's your crab's personality.
For Brain Fuel we use Z dot A I with GLM. On a coding plan, pick Coding API, then paste your key. It stays hidden.
Keep the default model. Skip Always On and Make It Yours for now. Every check passes, and you're in.
Your crab says hello first, no typing needed. Yours will be different, but OpenCrabs is installed and running.
If macOS keeps asking whether Terminal can access data from other apps, give Terminal Full Disk Access once, in System Settings, Privacy and Security.
From now on, just type opencrabs in any terminal. To update, type slash evolve inside OpenCrabs. It handles the rest.
Next up: connect Telegram, and chat with your crab from your phone. See you there.
